title: Sandbagging Detection Transfer: MALT Monitor on Code Evaluation Tasks vs. Math Evaluation Tasks

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: if sandbagging monitors are domain-specific, every new evaluation domain requires retraining. This directly informs whether current monitoring results transfer, which is critical for capability evaluation integrity.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires fine-tuning a monitor on MALT sandbagging examples, then creating a separate labeled math-evaluation sandbagging dataset with human raters. The labeled dataset creation for math sandbagging is a significant undertaking requiring domain expertise and labeling resources.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two separate datasets (code and math), monitor fine-tuning, human labeling of math sandbagging. The human labeling component alone could exceed 30 hours. Scope is broader than it appears.
